title: monolophus sirirugsae
intro: Monolophus sirirugsae, commonly known as Thai rosewood, is a plant species native to Thailand, characterized by its fragrant and woody properties. The plant has been traditionally used in Thai medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Monolophus sirirugsae are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including cinnamaldehyde, cinnamic acid, and linalool, which exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's potential in treating various health conditions, making it a valuable resource in traditional Thai medicine.
